protocol.text_content: Existing pipeline description + tags + objects; excludes OCR and filename
protocol.primary_two_vectors: Equal reciprocal rank fusion, k=60, complete corpus ranking
protocol.primary_one_vector: One compute_embedding([ImageFile, document_text]) call, not averaging
protocol.primary_queries: 42 answerable content queries excluding OCR exact and filenames
protocol.other_queries: OCR exact, filenames and four no-match controls reported separately
protocol.lexical_search: Excluded equally from both sides to isolate vector architecture
protocol.metrics: Hit@1, Hit@5, MRR, Recall@5, nDCG@5; paired disagreements
protocol.tuning: None; frozen labels, equal weights; diagnostics do not replace primary comparison
protocol.scale_timing: 30k repeated copies of fixture vectors; time/storage only, no quality claim

scale.note: Exact in-memory numpy scan and ranking; repeated synthetic vectors, no vector DB or network.
